metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat  team is back from Madhya Pradesh after week long stay in Tribal areas of the state. We will be putting out a series of new episode of Main Bhi Bharat from these areas. But before that we have organised this quiz for you, based on the tribes of Madhya Pradesh. If you answer correctly, you stand a chance to win a prize.
